$comment: Deterministic continuity across the compaction boundary. SessionStart fires with source ∈ startup|resume|clear|compact; the matcher scopes injection to resume|compact ONLY — fresh sessions stay clean (the trigger-gated `syne align` directive covers those), while resumed/compacted sessions get a small, hard-capped self-align brief (memories index + recent sessions + Codex context, never a transcript) injected as context with no model discretion involved. The `command -v` guard makes the hook a silent no-op when `syne` isn't on PATH. Remove the SessionStart entry to opt out.
